# M11 follow-up register and additional-source decision

## Current update — 30 September 2026

This update supersedes the dated snapshots below; `PLAN.md` remains authoritative.

- **Selected route:** [the corrected Space Bunny screen](m12-space-bunny-corrected-result-2026-09-30.md) passed its frozen gates with 200 responses. [The released public flow](m12-free-default-public-acceptance-2026-09-30.json) completed 71/71 tasks with 178 observed/priced responses, reported $0 and unchanged account usage. Its 29 recovered API-error attempts and citation limitations remain visible; this is not expert validation or superiority over untested models.
- **Ling Sante:** [the configuration-specific disposition](baseline/model-qualification/ling-sante-disposition-2026-09-30.md) rejects the pinned Novita/model/request configuration under its existing repeated-completed-failure rule. Two completed primary judgments missed the frozen partial-support label; the third trial's separate incomplete verifier does not erase those results. Other configurations are not assessed.
- **Cloudflare larger-output variant:** remains untested and unqualified. The tested 1,024-output-token closing tool turn truncated; no larger-budget result exists. Privacy/retention is waived. Unattended free-plan admission, completed tool behavior and scientific quality are unproven. No new probe is authorized or performed. The campaign contract permits an unselected alternative to remain unqualified without blocking the selected-route release; full candidate reconciliation remains M12-04b7.
- **Novelty:** the sole admitted v1 pilot stopped on missing maintained PubMed tracing and remains inconclusive; its consumed marker prevents replay. Offline trace repair and a separately registered fresh-input study precede any further scientific calls. The prior precise-rung rejection is a separate mechanism.
- **Robin:** [the distinct public continuation](m12-robin-continuation-acceptance-2026-09-30.json) completed all 17 new tasks, produced a source-linked single-parent child, traversed ordinary review/reflection/safety/verification/claims/ranking/report gates, and survived browser refresh. Its 30 observed/priced responses reported $0; deep verification weakened the child, so operational acceptance does not establish experimental validity. The old ambiguous action was not replayed. Final campaign acceptance remains open.

No inference was sent.

**27 September route update:** The owner waived retention restrictions for
campaign-owned public inputs. Exact-zero `stealth/space-bunny-alpha` then
completed one local public research run and its route code was released in
[PR #60](m12-space-bunny-release-2026-09-27.json). This supersedes the old
"no available route" screening snapshot, but it does not qualify a scientific
default: [the run assessment](m12-space-bunny-full-run-assessment-2026-09-27.md)
records weak central claim support, no matched quality comparison, and no
production role readback or public production run. The historical Qwen, Ling,
Groq and Cloudflare dispositions remain unchanged. Zero spending remains a gate.

Current provider-source research identifies [Cloudflare Workers AI Free](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/) as a distinct conditional route: its Free plan stops at 10,000 Neurons/day rather than billing overage, and its [data-use policy](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/data-usage/) says customer content is not used for model training or service improvement. Its [documented JSON Mode model list](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/features/json-mode/) and long-context model options do not yet establish one route that satisfies every project interface; no Cloudflare account or credential is confirmed, and no project call was made. [Cerebras terms](https://www.cerebras.ai/terms-of-service) prohibit benchmarking or competitive analysis of its service, so its time-limited trial is not selected for this campaign. [GitHub Models](https://docs.github.com/en/github-models) was retired on 30 July 2026, including its inference API, so the existing GitHub login cannot supply this route. These are research dispositions, not qualifications or authorizations to change defaults.

On 26 September Chrome showed a saved Cloudflare Google sign-in profile, but the dashboard was still at `/login`. The button states that continuing agrees to Cloudflare's terms and privacy policy; no sign-in, agreement acceptance, account-plan readback or key creation occurred. The [Llama 3.3 70B](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast/) route has documented tools, streaming and JSON Mode but only a 24,000-token context, while [GPT-OSS 120B](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/gpt-oss-120b/) has a 128,000-token context and tools but is absent from the [JSON Mode support list](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/features/json-mode/). These are static capability facts, not a compatible single-route or scientific-quality result. User confirmation is required before the sign-in action that accepts terms; account Free status and actual product fit remain unknown.

Later on 26 September the owner confirmed this was an existing sign-in, and a fresh Chrome read showed the account dashboard already authenticated without another sign-in action. Billing lists **Workers Free** as active. The separate R2 Paid subscription is unrelated to inference and must not be used by this campaign. The account API-token list contained one R2-scoped token and no Workers AI token. The dashboard's Workers AI REST setup requires a token; a 30-day draft limited to Workers AI Read and Write was prepared on its review screen but **not created**. The [current pricing page](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/) says Workers Free has 10,000 free Neurons/day and fails excess operations rather than billing them, while [Cloudflare's REST guide](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/get-started/rest-api/) requires both Workers AI Read and Edit for a custom token. Token creation, bounded live calls, interface fit and scientific qualification remain open; no account or product settings were changed.

Static compatibility screen before any Cloudflare call: the [OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/configuration/open-ai-compatibility/) accepts a model ID at an account-scoped `ai/v1` base URL and documents `options.rejectIfBusy` to fail instead of queueing on unavailable capacity. [Gemma 4 26B A4B](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai/models/%40cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it/) is a provisional first candidate because its documented 256,000-token context, tool calling and streaming cover the largest obvious interface needs within Workers Free's hard cap. Its absence from the [JSON Mode support list](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/features/json-mode/) means schema behavior is **unproven**, not compatible by declaration; prompt-only JSON and current-product scientific quality would both need bounded tests. The existing `engine/src/co_scientist/llm_free_policy.py` admits only OpenRouter routes, so a Cloudflare trial would need a provisional fail-closed adapter at the real request boundary before any campaign inference. No adapter or model call has been made.

Subsequently, commit `eb0ed45d` added that [offline provisional adapter and assessment](baseline/model-qualification/cloudflare-workers-free-candidate-2026-09-26.md). It admits only the exact Gemma candidate on the current-day attested Workers Free account, pins the endpoint and token, prevents LiteLLM from silently dropping JSON parameters, and fails fast on busy capacity. Public LLM/JSON boundary tests passed with mocked transport; no real token, model call, default switch or deployment followed. The model page's generic API schema lists `response_format` and `max_completion_tokens` but states no guaranteed 24,000-token output limit or model-specific JSON compliance. Those capabilities, scientific accuracy and a sustainable unattended Free-plan admission remain unverified. M11-OPS-02c is still open.

Later in that 26 September investigation, the owner approved a dedicated 30-day Workers AI token and two bounded live interface cases. The small JSON case passed; the synthetic tool loop stopped after its closing response exhausted 1,024 output tokens without an answer. The [Cloudflare candidate record](baseline/model-qualification/cloudflare-workers-free-candidate-2026-09-26.md) retains the exact frozen evidence and unresolved privacy and unattended Free-plan gates. On 27 September the unqualified provisional adapter and one-off probes were removed from the active tree before PR #53's production release; their historical source remains at `2db00ba0`. No Cloudflare route, default, or credential was deployed, and this outcome does not qualify a replacement model.

[Hugging Face Inference Providers](https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers/en/pricing) gives a Free account $0.10 in monthly credits, then requires purchased credits for further use. Those credits offset metered provider prices rather than establishing an exact-zero route under this campaign's admission rule; this host also has no Hugging Face token or CLI login. Its [routing privacy policy](https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers/security) delegates provider-specific handling to each provider. No account, paid credits, model call or product integration was attempted.

## Additional repository selection

**Selected: zero.** Each unresolved mechanism has a pinned required-source
comparison and an exact local or official-service boundary to test. No proposed
additional repository supplies a distinct missing mechanism or a provider-backed
replay guarantee that these investigations require. Another general Co-Scientist
clone would duplicate the nine required implementation comparisons; another
broad tool catalog would not establish the GWAS service's live behavior or terms.
Those categories are excluded for this campaign, not assessed as defective
software. If a concrete gap appears during the remaining acceptance work, record
its evidence in `PLAN.md` before reconsidering this decision; the three-source
ceiling and the existing turn limit remain.
